titleEn: Longest Continuous Subarray With Absolute Diff Less Than or Equal to Limit
title: 绝对差不超过限制的最长连续子数组
summary: 求最长连续子数组，使其中任意两元素的绝对差都不超过 limit。
insight: 条件等价于窗口最大值减最小值不超过 limit。分别用递减和递增双端队列维护最大最小值，并移动左边界恢复合法。
pitfalls: 队列保存下标以便移除过期元素
加入新值后再收缩窗口
答案是合法窗口长度最大值

solutions.title: 双单调队列滑窗
solutions.idea: 常数时间查询窗口极值。
steps: right 加入两队列；当 nums[maxFront]-nums[minFront]>limit 时递增 left 并移除对应过期队首
更新 right-left+1 的最大值

code.java: class Solution { public int longestSubarray(int[] nums,int limit){Deque<Integer> maximum=new ArrayDeque<>(),minimum=new ArrayDeque<>();int left=0,answer=0;for(int right=0;right<nums.length;right++){while(!maximum.isEmpty()&&nums[maximum.peekLast()]<nums[right])maximum.removeLast();while(!minimum.isEmpty()&&nums[minimum.peekLast()]>nums[right])minimum.removeLast();maximum.addLast(right);minimum.addLast(right);while(nums[maximum.peekFirst()]-nums[minimum.peekFirst()]>limit){if(maximum.peekFirst()==left)maximum.removeFirst();if(minimum.peekFirst()==left)minimum.removeFirst();left++;}answer=Math.max(answer,right-left+1);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun longestSubarray(nums:IntArray,limit:Int):Int{val maximum=java.util.ArrayDeque<Int>();val minimum=java.util.ArrayDeque<Int>();var left=0;var answer=0;for(right in nums.indices){while(maximum.isNotEmpty()&&nums[maximum.peekLast()]<nums[right])maximum.removeLast();while(minimum.isNotEmpty()&&nums[minimum.peekLast()]>nums[right])minimum.removeLast();maximum.addLast(right);minimum.addLast(right);while(nums[maximum.peekFirst()]-nums[minimum.peekFirst()]>limit){if(maximum.peekFirst()==left)maximum.removeFirst();if(minimum.peekFirst()==left)minimum.removeFirst();left++};answer=maxOf(answer,right-left+1)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int longestSubarray(vector<int>& nums,int limit){deque<int> maximum,minimum;int left=0,answer=0;for(int right=0;right<(int)nums.size();++right){while(!maximum.empty()&&nums[maximum.back()]<nums[right])maximum.pop_back();while(!minimum.empty()&&nums[minimum.back()]>nums[right])minimum.pop_back();maximum.push_back(right);minimum.push_back(right);while(nums[maximum.front()]-nums[minimum.front()]>limit){if(maximum.front()==left)maximum.pop_front();if(minimum.front()==left)minimum.pop_front();++left;}answer=max(answer,right-left+1);}return answer;} };
